tests.name: test_scalar_fast_path_equality
tests.intent: Probes the fast inline scalar equality operator for various matching types including null, booleans, and numbers.

tests.name: test_scalar_fast_path_less
tests.intent: Probes the fast inline scalar less-than operator for integers, unsigned, and floats.

tests.name: test_copy_constructor_scalars
tests.intent: Probes the copy constructor for non-owning scalar types using the optimized union copy path.

tests.name: test_copy_constructor_owning
tests.intent: Probes the copy constructor for owning types (strings, arrays, objects, binaries) invoking copy_owning.

tests.name: test_json_value_init_owned
tests.intent: Probes the allocation path init_owned for string, array, object, and binary value types.

tests.name: test_json_value_destroy
tests.intent: Probes the inline owns_memory check and out-of-line destroy_owned cleanup lifecycle path.

tests.name: test_equal_general_mixed_types
tests.intent: Probes equal_general fallback when comparing mixed types or non-scalar types.

tests.name: test_less_general_mixed_types
tests.intent: Probes less_general fallback for mixed types and structured comparisons.

tests.name: test_container_bounded_equality
tests.intent: Probes object and array container bounded structural equality comparisons directly.

tests.name: test_nan_comparisons
tests.intent: Probes special NaN floating point comparisons and unordered behaviors.

tests.name: test_discarded_value_handling
tests.intent: Probes behaviors and comparisons involving discarded json values.

tests.name: test_vector_json_lifecycle
tests.intent: Probes large vector construction, copying, and destruction of mixed-type json elements.

tests.name: test_three_way_comparison_scalars
tests.intent: Probes C++20 three-way comparison operator (<=>) on scalar types when available.

tests.name: test_signed_unsigned_number_comparison
tests.intent: Probes comparison between signed and unsigned integer number types using general or fast paths.

tests.name: test_binary_value_lifecycle
tests.intent: Probes binary data value type creation, copy, destruction, and equality.

tests.name: test_string_leaf_comparison
tests.intent: Probes string comparisons via the leaf comparison helper functions.

tests.name: test_nested_containers_lifecycle
tests.intent: Probes deeply nested object and array allocations, copy constructors, and recursive cleanups.

tests.name: test_exception_handling_bad_get
tests.intent: Probes exception handling when type mismatches occur during value access.

tests.name: test_json_value_assignment_scalar
tests.intent: Probes assignment operator changes between various scalar value types.

tests.name: test_json_equality_operator_not_equals
tests.intent: Probes inequality (!=) operator across scalar and non-scalar values.

tests.name: test_owns_memory_and_init_owned
tests.intent: Exercises detail::owns_memory for array, string, binary and boolean, and triggers init_owned and copy_owning via constructor and copy operations.

tests.name: test_equal_general_and_three_way
tests.intent: Invokes equal_general, less_general, and three_way_general via mixed-type or general comparisons.

tests.name: test_equal_leaf_and_bounded_containers
tests.intent: Exercises equal_leaf and container structural comparison paths directly through nested object and array equality checks.

tests.name: test_scalar_fast_operators
tests.intent: Exercises JSON_IMPLEMENT_SCALAR_FAST for equality and three-way comparison on matched scalar types.

tests.name: test_recursion_limit_and_unequal_containers
tests.intent: Exercises container size mismatch checks and recursion depth limit fallbacks during equality comparison.

tests.name: test_binary_value_lifecycle_fixed
tests.intent: Probes binary data value type creation, copy, destruction, and equality.
